citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The active teaching protocols did not include a rationale for the appropriateness of the number of animals to be used. The
protocols contained the number of animals to be used per year but did not include how these numbers were calculated.
An animal use proposal must include the rationale for the appropriateness of the numbers of animals to be used so that
the IACUC can conduct a thorough review of the components of the activities related to the care and use of animals and
determine that the proposed activities are in accordance with the Animal Welfare Act. Correct by ensuring that protocols
contain rationale for the appropriateness of the number of animals to be used. Correct by 20-JULY-2026.

The facility could not provide a record of the meeting minutes for the IACUC meeting held on 1/14/2026. A facility
representative was asked for the meeting minutes and they stated that those records were never created. Maintaining
meeting minutes is important to document IACUC activities, reviews, discussions, and deliberations and helps
demonstrate the functionality of the IACUC. A research facility shall maintain IACUC records such as minutes of IACUC
meetings, including records of attendance, activities of the Committee, and Committee deliberations. Correct by ensuring
that meeting minutes are recorded and maintained. Correct by 6-JULY-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representatives.

narrative:
2.31(e)(2) 
   
Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC). 
The active teaching protocols did not include a rationale for the appropriateness of the number of animals to be used. The 
protocols contained the number of animals to be used per year but did not include how these numbers were calculated. 
An animal use proposal must include the rationale for the appropriateness of the numbers of animals to be used so that 
the IACUC can conduct a thorough review of the components of the activities related to the care and use of animals and 
determine that the proposed activities are in accordance with the Animal Welfare Act. Correct by ensuring that protocols 
contain rationale for the appropriateness of the number of animals to be used. Correct by 20-JULY-2026. 
2.35(a)(1) 
   
Recordkeeping requirements. 
The facility could not provide a record of the meeting minutes for the IACUC meeting held on 1/14/2026. A facility 
representative was asked for the meeting minutes and they stated that those records were never created. Maintaining 
meeting minutes is important to document IACUC activities, reviews, discussions, and deliberations and helps 
demonstrate the functionality of the IACUC. A research facility shall maintain IACUC records such as minutes of IACUC 
meetings, including records of attendance, activities of the Committee, and Committee deliberations. Correct by ensuring 
that meeting minutes are recorded and maintained. Correct by 6-JULY-2026. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representatives.
